scope: Fresh confirmation of one-expert and FP4-input candidates, plus predeclared FP4 expert-weight error pilot. No weight adaptation.
fp4_weights: Quantize/dequantize routed expert matrices once before timing; stores decoded FP32 weights and computes BF16 GEMMs. Tests weight-error tolerance only; neither packed weight residency nor native FP4 GEMM speed is measured.
selection: One expert gives the fastest routed candidate; FP4 input fidelity remained high in calibration. Other activation/normalization/branch-removal candidates were dominated by routed expert-count reduction.
